proposed_from.topic: Quadratic-query reconstruction certificates for nonlinear latent hierarchies. On the unchanged Prashant--Ng--Zhang--Huang ICLR 2025 scalar layered-DAG class with two pure children per latent, equal measured-descendant path lengths, differentiability, conditional sufficiency, and generalized rank faithfulness, construct deterministic RankPeel using only essential-supremum ranks of observed conditional-mean Jacobians. Prove exact parentless detection, <=1 pairwise recovery of every pure block, the representative neutrality iff Pa(c) subset P, recursive full-adjacency recovery up to within-layer permutation, at most p^2+p oracle calls, O(p^3) bookkeeping, and an oracle-relative replayable certificate. Use query-specific private-path lower bounds and restricted pure-surrogate separator upper bounds; do not assume a blanket rank=minimum-separator identity, faithfulness inheritance after latent contraction, an extra saturated-rank condition, or practical CelebA consistency. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: disjoint private-path and restricted surrogate-separation arguments derive the exact rank k versus k+1 parent test at every level; 4,408 exact multilevel rational rank checks, a 36-vertex/39-edge reconstruction in 362 calls, and 192 representative-choice cases passed, while isolated blocks, parentless vertices, proportional unfaithful twins, discarded mixed descendants, correlated parents, and misleading blanket separator identities were checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: independently validate the anchor's conditional separator-to-Jacobian-rank upper bound under its exact Conditions 1--3. EARLY KILL TEST: enumerate the specified 676 three-level DAGs with two extra mixed measured children and verify every proposed surrogate cut by exact d-separation; any legal counterexample stops the proof. seed_details.title: Certified quadratic-query RankPeel reconstruction
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 3, Lemmas 1--3, Appendix A.7, Introduction, and Conclusion
seed_details.opened_evidence: The published recursion establishes identification but searches subset families, invokes latent-level ranks after peeling, and gives neither an observed-query bound nor a replayable transcript.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the all-subsets pure-child criterion by the pairwise test \(\rho_\ell(\{u,v\},V_\ell\setminus\{u,v\})\le 1\), then replace parent-set subset search by one-parent-at-a-time neutrality deletion.
seed_details.destination_search: The inspected nonlinear hierarchy papers use representation recovery or differentiable optimization; the inspected rank-based hierarchy paper uses linear covariance ranks and recursive latent covers. None states the same-class observed-Jacobian protocol, the \(p^2+p\) query bound, or replay certificates.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: On the unchanged scalar layered-DAG class, deterministic RankPeel exactly recovers every pure block and every adjacent-layer edge up to within-layer permutation using at most \(p^2+p\) observed conditional-mean-Jacobian rank queries and \(O(p^3)\) bookkeeping.
seed_details.open_content: Validate the restricted separator-to-rank upper bound under the anchor's exact analytic conditions and prove the private-surrogate invariant for every recursive query.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is immediate from Prashant et al. because their Theorem 3 already identifies the graph recursively.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their proof searches subset families and changes to latent-level rank objects; the proposed theorem supplies a different pairwise and deletion construction, an observed-only query bound, full adjacency output, and locally replayable witnesses.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole RankPeel angle was exhausted when its unchanged-class oracle was refuted by conditional-version instability; support regularity yields only a substituted strict-subclass kernel.

seed_details.title: Restricted separator-to-Jacobian-rank theorem under the published conditions
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1 and Appendix proof of Theorem 1
seed_details.opened_evidence: The proof writes the observed conditional mean as \(h\circ g\) and applies the chain rule, although the stated condition makes \(g\) and the composite continuously differentiable without separately making \(h\) differentiable.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace differentiation of the induced map \(h\) by a topological bottleneck argument: a rank-\(r\) minor of the composite creates a locally embedded \(r\)-dimensional slice, on which the continuous \(k\)-dimensional sufficient map would have to be injective.
seed_details.destination_search: Trek separation supplies an algebraic factorization only for linear Gaussian covariance matrices. The nonlinear hierarchy papers inspected do not supply the missing regular-conditional-distribution or topological-factorization lemma.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: For every separator cut actually issued by RankPeel, the anchor's Conditions 1--3 imply \(R(A,B)\le |Z|\) without assuming differentiability of the induced map or a blanket minimum-separator identity.
seed_details.open_content: Establish the result for almost-everywhere versions of conditional expectations and identify the minimal version-stability requirement.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The upper bound is already proved by the chain rule in Prashant et al.
seed_details.rebuttal: The published hypotheses do not state the differentiability needed for that chain rule; a proof under the exact hypotheses is a foundational repair used by every subsequent rank-identification claim.

seed_details.title: Oracle-query lower bound for latent-hierarchy reconstruction
seed_details.opened_evidence: The anchor gives no oracle decision-tree complexity, leaving open whether quadratic queries are intrinsic or merely sufficient.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a relatively open faithful family whose mixed-child parent matrices encode many distinguishable graphs while each admissible rank query has a controlled answer alphabet.
seed_details.destination_search: No inspected latent-hierarchy paper proves a rank-oracle lower bound for complete adjacency recovery.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Characterize the minimax deterministic query complexity of exact reconstruction and seek an \(\Omega(p^2/\log p)\) or sharper lower bound matched by RankPeel up to logarithms.
seed_details.open_content: Build an adversarial faithful graph family for which adaptive block queries cannot reveal many parent bits simultaneously.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A counting argument makes the lower bound routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: Rank answers take multiple integer values and large block queries can aggregate many edges, so the needed adversarial indistinguishability family is not delivered by graph counting alone.

seed_details.title: Query-restricted conditional-sufficiency frontier
seed_details.anchor_location: Condition 3(ii), proof of Theorem 1, and Conclusion
seed_details.opened_evidence: The conclusion explicitly identifies relaxation of the differentiability and conditional-sufficiency condition as future work, while the reconstruction proof uses only a restricted family of rank upper bounds.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the global density factorization \(p(z\mid x)=p(z\mid g(x))\) by a query-indexed factorization of only the relevant conditional-mean maps through continuous \(|Z|\)-dimensional bottlenecks.
seed_details.destination_search: Kong et al. use invertible recovery of latent variables and disturbances, which is a different and stronger route; no inspected paper characterizes the weakest operator condition for these restricted Jacobian queries.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Give necessary and sufficient observable-operator conditions for all RankPeel query ranks, with a counterexample immediately outside the condition.
seed_details.open_content: Prove necessity without building the answer into a named surrogate map and determine whether a common bottleneck is required across adaptive queries.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This merely renames Condition 3 on a smaller query set.
seed_details.rebuttal: An acceptable result must give both directions and a boundary counterexample, not assume the queried rank inequalities or restate the published sufficient statistic.

seed_details.title: Generic nonlinear Jacobian-rank faithfulness
seed_details.anchor_location: Proposition 1 and Appendix proof of Proposition 1
seed_details.opened_evidence: The proposition invokes independently continuously drawn matrix entries, whereas Jacobian factors generated by one structural model are functionally dependent and the unrestricted function class has no canonical Lebesgue measure.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Specify a finite-dimensional analytic SEM parameterization and witness one nonzero queried minor per graphically unentailed constraint before applying analytic zero-set arguments.
seed_details.destination_search: Sullivant, Talaska, and Draisma obtain genericity from nonzero trek determinant polynomials in linear Gaussian models; no inspected nonlinear hierarchy paper supplies the analogous parameterized minor argument.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Show that generalized rank faithfulness for the finite RankPeel query family holds outside a proper analytic subset of a specified nonlinear SEM parameter space, or exhibit an open family of structural cancellations.
seed_details.open_content: Choose a parameterization broad enough to be substantively nonlinear while retaining a rigorous genericity measure and dependent Jacobian factors.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Generic full rank follows immediately because rank-deficient matrices have Lebesgue measure zero.
seed_details.rebuttal: That argument fails for structurally dependent matrix factors; the missing contribution is to prove the relevant determinant is not identically zero on the SEM parameter image.

seed_details.title: Complete inconsistency certificates for rank transcripts
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 3 and the released algorithmic formulation
seed_details.opened_evidence: The anchor returns a graph under its model assumptions but does not characterize which observed rank transcripts are incompatible with every graph in the class.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn pairwise clique failures, dimension violations, and mutually inconsistent neutrality answers into a finite obstruction system indexed by the same observed queries.
seed_details.destination_search: The inspected recovery results provide correctness under assumptions, not completeness of an observed-rank rejection certificate for this nonlinear class.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Characterize a polynomially checkable family of transcript obstructions that is sound, and determine whether it is complete for membership in the RankPeel rank-pattern image.
seed_details.open_content: Completeness may require global constraints beyond the local peeling transcript.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The certificate is just a log of the algorithm and says nothing about assumption failure.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed is retained only in its stronger obstruction-completeness form; a replay log alone is assigned to the main reconstruction seed as a corollary.

seed_details.title: Asynchronous peeling without equal measured-descendant depth
seed_details.opened_evidence: Equal measured-descendant path length creates the layer alignment used by recursion but is not characterized as necessary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the common active layer by a frontier of pure-surrogate trees of unequal depths and characterize which frontier updates preserve separator cuts.
seed_details.destination_search: The inspected nonlinear hierarchy and linear rank-recovery papers impose their own layer or latent-cover restrictions and do not give an exact frontier for unequal-depth observed leaves under conditional-mean Jacobian ranks.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Characterize when an asynchronous RankPeel frontier identifies the full DAG without the equal-depth condition, with a pair of observationally equivalent graphs at the boundary.
seed_details.open_content: Find a graph-invariant observable rule for deciding which surrogate blocks may be advanced without exposing discarded mixed descendants.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Unequal depth is a routine bookkeeping extension.
seed_details.rebuttal: The current surrogate-separation proof relies on a common attachment level; advancing one branch can change both the endpoint class and the valid cut, so necessity and a boundary witness are substantive.

seed_details.title: Observed-parent nonlinear hierarchy recovery
seed_details.anchor_location: Conclusion discussion of measured variables with children
seed_details.opened_evidence: The conclusion excludes structures in which measured variables have children and names their inclusion as future work.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Modify parentless detection because rank zero against the observed complement no longer distinguishes a measured root from a measured parent whose effects propagate downward.
seed_details.destination_search: Dong et al. treat causally related hidden variables in a linear partially observed network, but the inspected literature contains no nonlinear conditional-mean-Jacobian analogue with certified complete recovery.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Recover the partially observed nonlinear DAG up to its unavoidable equivalence class using an augmented family of conditional-mean Jacobian queries.
seed_details.open_content: Characterize the exact equivalence class once observed-to-observed and observed-to-latent arrows are admitted.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Dong et al. already allow measured variables inside the causal network.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their linear rank setting and target differ; the seed survives only if it derives a nonlinear observed functional and an exact equivalence characterization rather than translating their algorithm.

seed_details.title: Finite-sample simultaneous RankPeel certification
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1, the differentiable population criterion, and experimental implementation
seed_details.opened_evidence: The population theory does not estimate the essential-supremum ranks along an adaptively selected transcript.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct simultaneous confidence bands for conditional-mean derivatives before composing them with nonregular trailing-singular-value rank decisions over the adaptive query tree.
seed_details.destination_search: Chen and Fang treat composite finite-matrix rank nulls, while Cattaneo, Feng, and Shigida treat uniform nonparametric regression functionals; no inspected result composes both pieces for adaptive latent-graph reconstruction.
seed_details.theorem_kernel: Give a sample-size and singular-value-margin condition under which every adaptive rank decision, the replay transcript, and the full graph are jointly correct with probability at least \(1-\alpha\).
seed_details.open_content: Control the essential supremum and selection over a query family whose membership depends on earlier noisy rank outcomes.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A union bound over at most \(p^2+p\) tests makes this immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform derivative estimation and composite-rank calibration at lower-rank boundary points are both nonregular; a union bound applies only after simultaneous valid query-level confidence events are derived.
